findings.finding: declared-name-absent accepted a free-text target_derivation, so an unrelated reachable target could be mapped to an absent name.
findings.fix: target_derivation is removed from the schema. The row must carry a non-empty structured evidence.targets list; target is in that list; every listed target is a candidate; claim.subjects is exactly [declared_name]; the name is absent from the image's defined symbols; present is False; and the dropped target is absent from the final upper bound. The oracle therefore refuses a reachable target mapped to an absent name.

The claim's per-caller mapping must equal the source for the same symbols; the dropped target must be in the excluded contribution union and not in the recomputed reachable union; admitted_targets must equal (reachable contributions) intersect the image symbols; and candidates must equal admitted plus excluded. Peak RSS 3.90 GiB against the default 4 GiB RLIMIT_DATA leaves little headroom; the graph and precision resolver dominate.

finding.finding: The record carried candidate_source.excluded_callers[0] = {symbol: OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all, contributed_targets: []} while 178 targets were dropped under not-contributed-by-reachable-callers. The excluded caller forwards its own parameter (recorded as the symbolic value (arg, 1)), so the v1.3 per-caller contribution, which read only literal values, recorded nothing. The site arg_targets is the flat union over all callers, computed by the argument-summary interpreter; per-caller attribution was computed only for reachable callers. This is a derivation gap, not a validator defect.
finding.repair: Attribute every caller row, reachable or excluded, with the same argument-summary expansion that produced arg_targets; record the per-call-site shape and make contributed_targets exactly the union of its own call-site targets. The excluded caller now contributes 178 targets with a 178-target call-site target-list witness (the `arguments[].targets` union; `witness_instruction` is empty for this row), and all 178 drops are recomputable from the record.

derivation_repair.row_shape: {symbol, function, reachable, reason, call_sites: [{call_site, arguments: [{argument_index, targets, value, non_image_values, unresolved, witness_instruction}]}], contributed_targets}
derivation_repair.attribution_source: PrecisionResolver argument summary (summary_vals), the same expansion used to build the site flat arg_targets; no name-based guess
derivation_repair.compatibility: v1 fields (argument, value, reachable_callers, excluded_callers, bounded_targets, argument_indices) are retained
derivation_repair.candidate_source: {kind: argument-targets, callers: [reachable rows with call_sites], excluded_callers: [excluded rows with call_sites], argued_by, targets, unattributed_targets}
derivation_repair.incidental_variation_rejected: Allowing an excluded direct caller with no recorded call arguments to bound the site (instead of refusing) resolved two additional sites (PEM_ASN1_write_bio_internal and one more): not-contributed-by-reachable-callers rose 178 -> 582 and resolved_by_reachable_caller 1 -> 3. That claims a candidate enumeration complete without a call record for that caller. The precondition was restored; no such movement is in the frozen result.

soundness_argument: Admitting a target is always safe for the upper bound: a candidate the enumeration already contains cannot be omitted by including it.
Excluding a target requires (i) the caller/writer is absent from the final-upper-bound oracle and (ii) the target is demonstrably produced by that subject.
Per-caller attribution is analyzer-produced from the same argument summary the flat target set came from; the call-site witness makes the contribution recomputable from the record.
Record-level validation checks the record against itself (contribution == union of its witnesses; admissions == source unattributed set) and against the oracle; it does not re-derive the image.
A bounding that cannot attribute any candidate is not emitted as a bounded set: the record is UNRESOLVED with the named incomplete-attribution property.

conservative_fallback.rule: a candidate that no caller row attributes is admitted into the site target set (monotone) and listed in unattributed_admissions; it is never dropped
conservative_fallback.zero_attribution: UNRESOLVED with missing_property 'caller attribution incomplete: <n> candidate target(s) have no attributable caller'
